why: The route <-> Figma frame mapping, and nothing else. This file is configuration: it says which frame of Cennso Design 4.0 a route is supposed to look like. It deliberately holds NO design values. A committed copy of the design goes stale the moment the designer edits the file, and a comparison against last month's design stays green while the site drifts — which is the exact failure this harness exists to prevent. The values are fetched live, per review, with get_design_context.

expandTheseSymbols.1:99: Header — the navigation. A frame screenshot renders it as a flat picture; only the expansion carries its typography, logo colour and CTA. Missing this is how the whole nav went unchecked in Phase 4.
expandTheseSymbols.1:575: Footer — the dark symbol. Note it declares NO fill of its own, so the band a reader sees is the frame fill behind it.
expandTheseSymbols.1:606: btn_More — the pill used for More and, with the label overridden, Send.

sharedImplementation.note: A change to any of these reaches every route, so it affects ALL six frames — not just the page whose file was edited.

frames.note: /contact carries the live Mailjet form. The review only reads computed style; it never types into the form and never submits it.
Light twin of contact-dark. Same read-only treatment of the form.
